description: Non-wound clinical lesion segmentation datasets (image + expert binary mask pairs) installed for the wound rebuild study. Binarise masks with mask > 127 for every set.

datasets.original_dataset: CVC-ClinicDB (CVC-612), 612 frames extracted from roughly 30 colonoscopy video sequences (31 polyps), 384x288
datasets.citation: Bernal J, Sanchez FJ, Fernandez-Esparrach G, Gil D, Rodriguez C, Vilarino F. WM-DOVA maps for accurate polyp highlighting in colonoscopy: Validation vs. saliency maps from physicians. Comput Med Imaging Graph. 2015;43:99-111.
datasets.source_paths: dataset/TrainDataset/{images,masks}/<1..612>.png (550 numeric-named frames) + dataset/TestDataset/CVC-ClinicDB/{images,masks} (62); union = all 612 frame IDs
datasets.mask_threshold: mask > 127 (masks are 0/255 PNG; a minority of frames carry a few anti-aliased intermediate values from the PraNet TIF-to-PNG conversion)
datasets.repo_licence: MIT (repo code); images are the PraNet (Fan et al., MICCAI 2020) TrainDataset/TestDataset redistribution; original dataset terms apply (research use, cite original paper)
datasets.pairing: image and mask share the filename stem; all image/mask sizes match
datasets.independence_notes: No overlap with Kvasir-SEG: 0 MD5 matches and 0 filename-stem matches against all 1000 Kvasir-SEG images; min distance between z-scored 16x16 grey thumbnails and any Kvasir-SEG image = 0.176 (no pair < 0.05; median within-set nearest-neighbour distance = 0.059). Different institution (Hospital Clinic Barcelona, CVC) from Kvasir (Vestre Viken, Norway). Frames are consecutive video frames grouped into ~30 video sequences (31 polyps), so frames are not independent; split by sequence, not by frame. Sequence IDs are not in this copy.

datasets.original_dataset: CVC-ColonDB, 380 frames from 15 sequences, 574x500 (PraNet test split version)
datasets.citation: Bernal J, Sanchez J, Vilarino F. Towards automatic polyp detection with a polyp appearance model. Pattern Recognition. 2012;45(9):3166-3182.
datasets.repo_licence: MIT (repo code); images are the PraNet (Fan et al., MICCAI 2020) TrainDataset/TestDataset redistribution; original dataset terms apply (research use, cite original paper)
datasets.pairing: image and mask share the filename stem; all image/mask sizes match
datasets.independence_notes: No overlap with Kvasir-SEG: 0 MD5 matches and 0 filename-stem matches against all 1000 Kvasir-SEG images; min distance between z-scored 16x16 grey thumbnails and any Kvasir-SEG image = 0.204 (no pair < 0.05; median within-set nearest-neighbour distance = 0.039). Different institution from Kvasir. Thumbnail check against cvc_clinicdb and etis_larib found no near duplicates (min 0.109 / 0.240). Video frames from 15 sequences: split by sequence. Note: CVC-300 (EndoScene test, 60 frames, available in the same source repo but not installed) is drawn from the CVC-ColonDB family and is not independent of this set.

datasets.original_dataset: ETIS-LaribPolypDB, 196 frames, 1225x966 (MICCAI 2015 polyp challenge test set)
datasets.citation: Silva J, Histace A, Romain O, Dray X, Granado B. Toward embedded detection of polyps in WCE images for early diagnosis of colorectal cancer. Int J Comput Assist Radiol Surg. 2014;9(2):283-293.
datasets.repo_licence: MIT (repo code); images are the PraNet (Fan et al., MICCAI 2020) TrainDataset/TestDataset redistribution; original dataset terms apply (research use, cite original paper)
datasets.pairing: image and mask share the filename stem; all image/mask sizes match
datasets.independence_notes: No overlap with Kvasir-SEG: 0 MD5 matches and 0 filename-stem matches against all 1000 Kvasir-SEG images; min distance between z-scored 16x16 grey thumbnails and any Kvasir-SEG image = 0.126 (no pair < 0.05; median within-set nearest-neighbour distance = 0.036). Different institution (Lariboisiere Hospital, Paris) from Kvasir and the CVC sets; no near duplicates against cvc_clinicdb/cvc_colondb. Frames come from 34 sequences (44 polyps): split by sequence.

datasets.original_dataset: PH2 dermoscopic image database (Hospital Pedro Hispano, Matosinhos), all 200 images (80 common nevi, 80 atypical nevi, 40 melanomas), ~768x560 8-bit RGB, expert lesion masks
datasets.citation: Mendonca T, Ferreira PM, Marques JS, Marcal ARS, Rozeira J. PH2 - A dermoscopic image database for research and benchmarking. 35th Annual Int Conf IEEE EMBC, 2013, pp. 5437-5440.
datasets.repo_licence: no LICENSE file in repo; PH2 terms: free for research use with citation of Mendonca et al. 2013. Repo README says ISIC 2017, but filenames (IMD002..IMD437), count (200) and size (768x576 class) identify it as PH2.
datasets.conversion: BMP images and BMP masks converted losslessly to PNG (pixel values unchanged); stems kept as IMDxxx
datasets.pairing: image and mask share the filename stem; all image/mask sizes match
datasets.independence_notes: No overlap with Kvasir-SEG: 0 MD5 matches and 0 filename-stem matches against all 1000 Kvasir-SEG images; min distance between z-scored 16x16 grey thumbnails and any Kvasir-SEG image = 0.343 (no pair < 0.05; median within-set nearest-neighbour distance = 0.176). Different modality entirely; no overlap with ISIC-derived sets checked here (PH2 is a separate Portuguese cohort).

datasets.original_dataset: TN3K (Thyroid Nodule 3493) official test split, 614 images from various devices/views, expert nodule masks
datasets.citation: Gong H, Chen G, Wang R, Xie X, Mao M, Yu Y, Chen F, Li G. Multi-task learning for thyroid nodule segmentation with thyroid region prior. IEEE ISBI 2021, pp. 257-261. Extended: Gong H, et al. Thyroid region prior guided attention for ultrasound segmentation of thyroid nodules. Comput Biol Med. 2023;155:106389.
datasets.source_paths: picture/test-image.part1.rar + part2.rar (614 JPG), picture/test-mask.rar (614 JPG); extracted with libarchive
datasets.repo_licence: MIT (repo); the authors describe TN3K as an open-access dataset and ask users to cite the papers above
datasets.conversion: JPEG masks re-saved as lossless PNG with original (anti-aliased) values kept; images kept as original JPG
datasets.mask_threshold: mask > 127 (JPEG masks have ~20-25 distinct grey levels from compression ringing; threshold at 127)
datasets.notes: Many images contain on-screen calipers/measurement marks. Some images have several nodules (multi-component masks). Trainval split (2879) was not installed: its masks extracted fine but the 6-volume image RAR hit a libarchive header CRC error after 1896 of 2879 images.
datasets.pairing: image and mask share the filename stem; all image/mask sizes match
datasets.independence_notes: No overlap with Kvasir-SEG: 0 MD5 matches and 0 filename-stem matches against all 1000 Kvasir-SEG images; min distance between z-scored 16x16 grey thumbnails and any Kvasir-SEG image = 0.398 (no pair < 0.05; median within-set nearest-neighbour distance = 0.414). Different modality entirely.
